title: Problem details
description: Body of every 4xx and 5xx response, sent as application/problem+json (RFC 9457). code and errors are extension members.

type.description: URI of the documentation for this kind of problem. Absent means about:blank.

title.description: Short summary of the kind of problem, for people. Do not branch on it.

status.description: HTTP status code of the response.

detail.description: Explanation of this occurrence, for people.

errors.description: One entry per query parameter, header or body field at fault.

name.description: Parameter or header name, or body field path such as attendees[2].email, as the client sent it.
